name: rubber-stamp
description: A rubber stamp with a broad grip, short central stem and flat stamping base.
useCase: Identify physical rubber stamps or document stamping tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific art material.

16.reason: The broad grip stays open above the short stem and full stamping base.

24.reason: The larger stamp retains a complete grip, open stem and broad flat base.
